The 2022 Philippine presidential election in Pangasinan was held on May 9, 2022, as part of the 2022 Philippine presidential election, in which all provinces, Highly Urbanized Cities, and Independent Component Cities participated. Pangasinan voters voters cast their ballots for president as part of the national popular vote. The province is composed of one independent component city, 3 component cities, and 44 municipalities, and in this election, it had 2,096,936 registered voters, making it one of the most vote-rich provinces in the country.
Pangasinan is the most populous province in the Ilocos Region. As part of the so-called "Solid North," it has historically leaned toward candidates with Ilocano ties. In the 2016 vice presidential election, Marcos received 813,709 votes in the province in contrast to Robredo's 260,694 votes.
